messages.subject: Project Ironhold - engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Andrew,

Good to speak just now. As discussed, I attach our engagement letter for the restructuring of the group's senior and shareholder debt (Project Ironhold). Subject to your sign-off we can move immediately: our first priorities are (1) agreeing the standstill with Northbank, and (2) getting Marlow started on the independent business review.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
